stem: Meera holds four objects up to a bright window in her classroom in Kochi and notes how much light passes through each. Only one object lets a small amount of light pass through, so the shapes seen through it look blurry and unclear. Which object is she describing?

teacher.key_rationale: The object lets some light through but makes shapes blurry, so it is translucent. Butter paper is translucent; the glass tumbler is transparent; the steel lunch box and wooden cover are opaque. Key B recalculated from the new scenario.
